paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging and BLEU score for three different models. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8, with tick labels at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 32. A purple solid line with square markers represents “Consistency-CE,” starting at 20.3 at x=1 and increasing to 28.8 at x=8. A blue dashed line with square markers represents “Inconsistency-CE,” beginning at 24.1 at x=1 and increasing to 29.7 at x=8. A red solid line with star markers represents “Consistency-Bi,” beginning at 26.7 at x=1 and increasing to 31.2 at x=8.
